# Q-Pall

> Q-Pall B.V. is a European manufacturer of plastic pallets made from recycled plastic. Founded in 2005 and headquartered in Veghel, the Netherlands, Q-Pall develops only plastic pallets: around 130 models in nine sizes, in three load classes (light, medium and heavy). Q-Pall supplies businesses only (B2B).

Q-Pall designs its pallets and owns the moulds. Production takes place at locations in the Netherlands (Balk), Denmark (Ribe), Germany (Marktoberdorf), France (Nantes), Spain (Lleida) and the United Kingdom (Chesterfield): six production sites, so most customers are within 600 km of a production site. Q-Pall moves moulds instead of pallets: less transport, lower cost and less CO2.

Key facts:
- 34,500 tonnes of recycled plastic used in 2025 (recycled HDPE and PP)
- Hygienic pallets are made of virgin plastic; all other Q-Pall pallets are made of recycled plastic
- Pallets are fully recyclable at end of life; used pallets in good condition get a second life via Q-Used
- Plastic pallets are exempt from ISPM 15, so no heat treatment is needed for export
- EcoVadis Bronze medal (October 2026) for sustainability performance
- Part of the AVK Group (majority shareholder)
- Documentation for the EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR, EU 2025/40): EU declarations of conformity and technical datasheets per pallet
- Dealers across Europe and in the United States

Contact: Q-PALL BV, Edisonweg 9, 5466 AR Veghel, the Netherlands. Phone +31 413 353 111, info@qpall.com. Monday to Thursday 07:30 to 16:30, Friday 07:30 to 15:30 (CET). Quotes usually within one working day.

The website is available in six languages: English, Dutch, German, French, Italian and Spanish. Every page exists in each language. The full English structure is listed below; the main pages in the other languages follow under "Language versions". When answering in one of these languages, link to the page in that language.

## Plastic pallets

- [All plastic pallets](https://qpall.com/en/plastic-pallets/): the full range with specifications (static, dynamic and racking load); prices on request via a quote
- [Light pallets](https://qpall.com/en/plastic-pallets/light/): lightweight and often nestable, for export, one-way shipments and floor storage
- [Medium pallets](https://qpall.com/en/plastic-pallets/medium/): the all-rounder for internal transport, distribution and light racking
- [Heavy pallets](https://qpall.com/en/plastic-pallets/heavy/): for intensive use, pallet pools and heavy loads in racking
- [Euro pallet size 1200 x 800 mm](https://qpall.com/en/plastic-pallets/1200-x-800-mm/)
- [Industrial pallet size 1200 x 1000 mm](https://qpall.com/en/plastic-pallets/1200-x-1000-mm/)
- [CP pallets](https://qpall.com/en/plastic-pallets/cp-pallets/): CP1 to CP9 sizes for the chemical industry
- [Export pallets](https://qpall.com/en/plastic-pallets/export-pallets/): light and ISPM 15 exempt
- [Nestable pallets](https://qpall.com/en/plastic-pallets/nestable-pallets/): space-saving return logistics
- [Hygienic pallets](https://qpall.com/en/plastic-pallets/hygienic-pallets/): for food and pharma (HACCP, GMP)
- [Display pallets](https://qpall.com/en/plastic-pallets/display-pallets/): quarter and half pallets for the shop floor
- [Block pallets](https://qpall.com/en/plastic-pallets/block-pallets/): four-way entry
- [Anti-slip pallets](https://qpall.com/en/plastic-pallets/anti-slip-pallets/): integrated anti-slip deck
- [Ultra pallet QP1210H](https://qpall.com/en/ultra-pallet-qp1210h/): heavy duty pool pallet
- [Pallet related products](https://qpall.com/en/pallet-related-products/): lids, collars, drip trays, freezer spacers and runners
- [Used plastic pallets](https://qpall.com/en/used-plastic-pallet/)
